Under legacy semantics, `model_snapshots` itself preserves the index, but the new tuple-index branch in `as_index` changes normalization regardless of the selected layout. For a network with tuple-valued timesteps, an input tuple index can denote valid timesteps under the old expansion logic while also matching full snapshot labels; the new branch interprets it as full labels instead. Thus the builders can receive different snapshots even with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
